font.reason: A neutral, legible Persian product UI face with real variable weights, matching the source interface's restrained sans-serif tone.

text.replacementScope: All visible page chrome, section labels, counts, filter control and ten project cards are typeset in Persian. Numerals shown in the UI use Persian digits.
text.typing: Six visible Persian letters enter as correctly shaped prefixes from frame 10 through frame 31. The ZWNJ is inserted together with the following ل, so it does not consume an empty visual beat. Filtering still begins at frame 42.

TypeAndFilter.action: Anchor the brand on the right and run the nav links to its left.
TypeAndFilter.why: Header order follows RTL reading order.

TypeAndFilter.action: Put headings at the right edge and counts at the left edge of the unchanged section rules.
TypeAndFilter.why: The labels identify rows from their reading start; the opposite count balances the line.

TypeAndFilter.action: Mirror the 1016-pixel search field and 76-pixel filter button; place the magnifier at the right of the query and the caret after the typed prefix toward the left.
TypeAndFilter.why: Search input starts at the Persian reading edge and the companion action moves to the opposite side.

TypeAndFilter.action: Mirror each card with x = 1920 - source x - width; right-align Persian card text and put age metadata at the left.
TypeAndFilter.why: The first card of each row belongs on the right in an RTL grid.

TypeAndFilter.action: Keep source index rank and 0.4-frame separation after mirroring card positions.
TypeAndFilter.why: Source indices already progress right-to-left within each mirrored row; reversing the indices would invert visual reading order.

TypeAndFilter.action: Mirror the original and destination x coordinates and keep destination y = 247, 10-frame ease, floating lift, scale, shadow and outline timing.
TypeAndFilter.why: The target must settle in the actual mirrored first-row slot while preserving the source motion beats.

TypeAndFilter.action: Mirror the click point and final camera cx; keep cy, zoom and frame keys.
TypeAndFilter.why: The camera must push into the card at its new RTL position.

TypeAndFilter.action: Keep radial expansion, vertical sinking, floating, shadow and zoom values.
TypeAndFilter.why: These represent physical motion rather than reading direction.

rasterHandling.source: projects-empty.png and ten English/Chinese card crops
rasterHandling.action: An opaque page-space paper layer covers the entire baked screenshot. The page header, sections, controls and all ten cards are rebuilt with live Persian text in the same measured geometry; the original textures remain unmodified and hidden.
rasterHandling.verification: Compared original and Persian stills at frames 0, 31, 46, 52, 61 and 72. No baked foreign text remains visible, including at the 2.2x push-in.

motionFidelity.timingAdjustment: The shorter Persian query distributes six visible letter steps across the source typing window, ending at frame 31; the 11-frame breath before frame 42 is retained.

concerns: The source prompt describes 25 departing non-target cards, but the actual isolated demo layout contains ten cards total and nine non-target cards. The implementation follows the actual source component and layout.

lessons.symptom: Blurred baked card screenshots hide foreign labels but make the filter result unreadable at the final 2.2x camera zoom.
lessons.cause: Blur removes the text hierarchy that carries the selected-card payoff.
lessons.fix: Cover the baked screenshot with an opaque page-space layer and rebuild the visible UI and card text in Persian at the source coordinates; retain the source camera and animation curves.

lessons.symptom: A ZWNJ in a Persian typewriter can create a frame where no visible letter is added.
lessons.cause: Prefix slicing counts the invisible join-control character as a step.
lessons.fix: Map visible-letter count to the underlying prefix length and insert the ZWNJ on the same beat as the following visible letter.
